title: The Code That Defeated Bletchley Park
description:
In 2004, the elite World War II codebreakers of Bletchley Park met their match. Having cracked the German Enigma and Lorenz ciphers, they were mobilized to solve a 250-year-old inscription carved on a stone monument at Shugborough Hall, only to find themselves completely defeated.

Discover the fascinating history of the Anson family, the mysterious alterations made to a classic painting, and the mathematical reality that makes this ten-letter sequence officially unsolvable.
